text: Namaste, main ek loan account band karwana chahta hoon. Mere paas thoda extra paisa aaya hai aur main saare bache hue EMI ek baar hi pay karke loan close karna chahta hoon. Mujhe batao kitna paisa dena padega aur kya koi extra charge lagega kya? Aur mujhe loan department se connect karo please.
